note: Re-judged 2026-11-03 by an independent auditor who authored none of ee1025b381. RFC 7947 Section 2.2.1: "As the route server does not participate in the actual routing of traffic, the NEXT_HOP attribute MUST be passed unmodified to the route server clients, similar to the "third-party" next-hop feature described in Section 5.1.3. of [RFC4271]." The sole carrier TestReactorForwardRSTransparent changed only in the x-1 claim comment (ExtractASPathPrependOps -> prependASPathOps); its body forwards NEXT_HOP 10.0.0.254 to an RS client and requires complete byte identity of a non-empty dispatch, so a rewritten or dropped next-hop fails. Discrimination record verified by ./le rfc discriminate: peer_forward_facts.go precomputeNextHop 'f.nhMode = nhModeNone' -> explicit 192.0.2.1 reddens it. The {single-polarity: positive} annotation stays justified: next-hop transparency is the default for every forwarded route, and the only rewrite is an explicit override feature, not an RS-confined negative. Verdict unchanged: enforced.
